_source: Kevin O'Brien / NBCG, 'International AD Siting and Community Protections' (https://github.com/kobrien-git/nbcg-ad-comparison). Policy information, not legal advice. No distance here is a proven safe distance.

rules.label: France: 200 m from the installation to third-party dwellings (ICPE 2781 authorisation)
rules.scope: Applies under the authorisation regime at 100 t/day or more. Measured from the installation, excluding raw-material-only storage. Other public receptors are assessed through impact and danger studies, not a fixed distance.

rules.label: Germany: 300 m to housing (500 m for specified open facilities) - TA Luft
rules.scope: Formal permit route from 50 t/day in the relevant category (industrial biological treatment). 500 m where specified facilities are open. The separate agricultural provision is different. Legal floors, not safety guarantees.

rules.label: Ontario: 200 m to dwellings, 450 m to Type B (sensitive / settlement) uses - MDS Publication 853
rules.scope: Rural and agricultural planning guidance (Minimum Distance Separation). Broad installation definition includes storage, loading, flare and separators. Not universal industrial law. Tonnage does not select the route.

rules.label: NBCG suggestion for evaluation: 300 m to dwellings, 500 m to schools, care settings and other high-sensitivity receptors
rules.scope: Suggested for evaluation by the group - not current Irish law. Measured from the nearest potentially odorous, noisy or hazardous component. 500 m to dwellings where reception, bunkers or digestate storage is open.

rules.label: Denmark: 50 m controls for specified livestock-farm components (not a whole-plant setback)
rules.scope: Component distances on livestock farms, not a universal whole-plant setback from homes. Shown for comparison only; no pass/fail verdict.

rules.label: Netherlands: 50 m external-safety distance from gas bags / liquefied-biogas tanks to the site boundary
rules.scope: An equipment-to-boundary gas-safety distance, not a dwelling setback. Activity tables add 100 m / 50 m distances for specified activities. Shown for comparison only; no pass/fail verdict.
